additions.label: Create zero-callback position decrease request
additions.description: Create a market/limit/stop-loss decrease request for the caller existing position, with no chosen callback or extension data and zero native value. Existing order-vault WNT fee provisioning remains external.
warnings: Static exact-root ABI/source inventory and a block-number-pinned orderHandler getter, not a persistent runtime, position, funding, market, keeper/oracle, execution-success or financial-safety guarantee. Grants, pauses, canonical calldata/value checks and final acceptance remain independent.

Only BSC56 ExchangeRouter 0x61e1116a943b27d21094599c2c5bd75e980170a5 createOrder under mandatory hertzflow-zero-callback-decrease-order-v1. OrderType must be 4 MarketDecrease, 5 LimitDecrease or 6 StopLossDecrease; callbackContract must be zero and dataList exactly empty. Swap/increase/liquidation/other order types, extension/bridge data and selected callbacks are not admitted.

Root fixes account=msg.sender and srcChainId=0 (current chain). Decrease collateral comes from the existing position identified by account, market, collateral token, long/short side and normal/ZFP type; it is not new collateral taken from a shared principal-vault delta. Position existence, balances, type eligibility, market/feature flags, trigger/acceptable prices and keeper settlement are checked on chain, not simulated by the catalog.

Zero native value is mandatory even though the ABI is payable: msg.value is not wrapped or attributed to the execution fee. The handler still records already-present order-vault WNT for fees, validates the declared fee as a lower funding bound and overwrites it with the recorded amount. There is no maximum-fee cap on this root path and no sender attribution for that shared fee delta. Existing safe atomic fee provisioning is a prerequisite outside this capability; no sendTokens/sendWnt, principal prefunding, fee transfer or complete workflow is admitted. The existing updateOrder path already uses the same fee-recording model.

Zero chosen callback is written directly into the new order. CallbackUtils returns before new-order execution/cancellation and execution-fee refund callbacks for address0. This does not disable token/native recipient code, configured dependencies or callbacks on other previously stored orders that automatic cancellation may touch. It is not a globally callback-free or atomic-settlement promise.

Empty dataList prevents caller-supplied extension/bridge instructions. Financial swapPath contains market addresses validated by the protocol, not arbitrary target+calldata pairs; no provider/opaque-oracle argument is added. Later keeper/oracle execution and mutable market/dependency configuration remain independent, including their source/identity limitations.

USD size and price fields use protocol1e30 precision; collateral/output/fee amounts use relevant native token decimals; validFromTime is seconds. A market decrease requires validFromTime0 on chain, while limit/stop conditions can delay or prevent execution. Slippage minima, leverage, funding/borrowing/price impact and profit sharing/fees can reduce proceeds; no full or immediate close is guaranteed.

Receiver and cancellationReceiver remain financial recipients; native unwrapping/refunds can run receiver code. Existing position-type/mode, autoCancel and referral bookkeeping remain source-defined behavior and do not install wallet/permit/operator/delegation authority. No new approval, signature or administrator role is granted.

Root and order-handler retained source-service creation/runtime grades are match/match, not exact_match. November2 ABI refreshes and the orderHandler() observation at BSC block0x7d22d2d agree with retained binding0x7e953baa1bb0d8b8e14008490c3ffd22f3ea6f1a. Linked libraries, the decrease executor, live Oracle/provider implementations and live state are not independently promoted or attested.

New createOrder grant is direct-only. Existing ten HertzFlow IDs, ABIs and finite multicall child graph are unchanged; an old update/cancel/multicall grant cannot activate this selector. LP/new-principal request creation and atomic withdrawal with opaque oracle parameters remain outside this scope.

Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, financial safety, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Existing grants, independent policy, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

BNB Smart Chain56 direct nonproxy ExchangeRouter0x61e1116a943b27d21094599c2c5bd75e980170a5 only. Current official SDK0.3.2 published2026-09-10 binds this address. Older August GitHub config and testnet-only address-table text are not used as current mainnet mappings. Sourcify runtime/creation grade is match, not exact_match. Fixed linked libraries and immutable handlers are retained; independent dependency safety is not attested.

Selected payable methods do not pull msg.value into user collateral or execution-fee accounting: use zero native value. No sendTokens/sendWnt, shared-pool prefunding, external-call executor, new callback registration, signature generation, bridge or permission method is admitted. LP/new-principal ingress remains excluded. A separately granted direct-only createOrder scope admits only existing-position decrease modes4/5/6 with zero chosen callback, empty extension data and zero native value; it does not widen this function or the old multicall child graph.

Cancellation keys must belong to msg.sender. Pending request removal refunds existing deposited token quantities, not an executed position close: deposit long/short tokens and withdrawal/shift market tokens return to recorded account. Order cancellation returns increase/swap collateral to recorded cancellationReceiver, falling back to account; execution-fee refund receiver is recorded cancellationReceiver or receiver. Native unwrapping follows stored request flags.

Existing stored callback and callback gas limits can be invoked on cancellation; these methods cannot choose a new callback or arbitrary calldata. Request expiry/feature gates, supported order type, gas and keeper fee rules apply; current feature state is not inferred from source. Requests originally created through multichain paths may credit an existing on-chain MultichainVault ledger rather than deliver a wallet token; no cross-chain send is admitted.

updateOrder changes only caller-owned supported nonmarket order sizeDeltaUsd, acceptablePrice, triggerPrice, minOutputAmount, validFromTime and autoCancel; it unfreezes/touches the request. USD/price fields use protocol1e30 precision, output token quantities native decimals, validFromTime seconds. Existing execution fee is revalidated; source recordTransferIn can consume already-present WNT but no prefunding helper or top-up workflow is admitted.

Fee/reward claims debit only msg.sender funding/UI/affiliate claimable ledger for each market/token; arrays must align and payout receiver must be valid. Collateral claims additionally bind timeKeys and subtract already-claimed amount after configurable claimable/reduction factors and delay, with floor rounding at1e30 precision. Payout token quantities use native token decimals. No rewards, claimability, fee amount, positive yield or execution timing is promised.

All operations inherit mutable feature/market/fee configuration, oracle/keeper settlement, existing callback/dependency and market-token balance checks. Trading profit/loss and fees can reduce eventual amounts. Existing protocol eligibility/ownership is not granted by catalog admission.

A separate exact same-target-financial-multicall-v1 root is now admitted with independent root/used-child grants, hashes, pauses and enforced zero outer native value; arbitrary multicall execution remains excluded.

Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, financial safety, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Existing grants, independent policy, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

All operations inherit mutable feature/market/fee configuration, oracle/keeper settlement, existing callback/dependency and market-token balance checks. Trading profit/loss and fees can reduce eventual amounts. Existing protocol eligibility/ownership is not granted by catalog admission.

A separate exact same-target-financial-multicall-v1 root is now admitted with independent root/used-child grants, hashes, pauses and enforced zero outer native value; arbitrary multicall execution remains excluded.

limitations: Static exact-root ABI/source inventory and a block-number-pinned orderHandler getter, not a persistent runtime, position, funding, market, keeper/oracle, execution-success or financial-safety guarantee. Grants, pauses, canonical calldata/value checks and final acceptance remain independent.

Only BSC56 ExchangeRouter 0x61e1116a943b27d21094599c2c5bd75e980170a5 createOrder under mandatory hertzflow-zero-callback-decrease-order-v1. OrderType must be 4 MarketDecrease, 5 LimitDecrease or 6 StopLossDecrease; callbackContract must be zero and dataList exactly empty. Swap/increase/liquidation/other order types, extension/bridge data and selected callbacks are not admitted.

Root fixes account=msg.sender and srcChainId=0 (current chain). Decrease collateral comes from the existing position identified by account, market, collateral token, long/short side and normal/ZFP type; it is not new collateral taken from a shared principal-vault delta. Position existence, balances, type eligibility, market/feature flags, trigger/acceptable prices and keeper settlement are checked on chain, not simulated by the catalog.

Zero native value is mandatory even though the ABI is payable: msg.value is not wrapped or attributed to the execution fee. The handler still records already-present order-vault WNT for fees, validates the declared fee as a lower funding bound and overwrites it with the recorded amount. There is no maximum-fee cap on this root path and no sender attribution for that shared fee delta. Existing safe atomic fee provisioning is a prerequisite outside this capability; no sendTokens/sendWnt, principal prefunding, fee transfer or complete workflow is admitted. The existing updateOrder path already uses the same fee-recording model.

Zero chosen callback is written directly into the new order. CallbackUtils returns before new-order execution/cancellation and execution-fee refund callbacks for address0. This does not disable token/native recipient code, configured dependencies or callbacks on other previously stored orders that automatic cancellation may touch. It is not a globally callback-free or atomic-settlement promise.

Empty dataList prevents caller-supplied extension/bridge instructions. Financial swapPath contains market addresses validated by the protocol, not arbitrary target+calldata pairs; no provider/opaque-oracle argument is added. Later keeper/oracle execution and mutable market/dependency configuration remain independent, including their source/identity limitations.

USD size and price fields use protocol1e30 precision; collateral/output/fee amounts use relevant native token decimals; validFromTime is seconds. A market decrease requires validFromTime0 on chain, while limit/stop conditions can delay or prevent execution. Slippage minima, leverage, funding/borrowing/price impact and profit sharing/fees can reduce proceeds; no full or immediate close is guaranteed.

Receiver and cancellationReceiver remain financial recipients; native unwrapping/refunds can run receiver code. Existing position-type/mode, autoCancel and referral bookkeeping remain source-defined behavior and do not install wallet/permit/operator/delegation authority. No new approval, signature or administrator role is granted.

Root and order-handler retained source-service creation/runtime grades are match/match, not exact_match. November2 ABI refreshes and the orderHandler() observation at BSC block0x7d22d2d agree with retained binding0x7e953baa1bb0d8b8e14008490c3ffd22f3ea6f1a. Linked libraries, the decrease executor, live Oracle/provider implementations and live state are not independently promoted or attested.

New createOrder grant is direct-only. Existing ten HertzFlow IDs, ABIs and finite multicall child graph are unchanged; an old update/cancel/multicall grant cannot activate this selector. LP/new-principal request creation and atomic withdrawal with opaque oracle parameters remain outside this scope.
